name: xipfax
description: Fax any document to any fax number with XipFax: add your pages, get the fax's price, send it, and get its confirmation. It also finds IRS offices' fax numbers.

interface.shortDescription: Fax any document to any number
interface.longDescription:
Fax any document to any fax number from your chat, with no fax machine.

Send a signed lease to a landlord, a claim to an insurer, a form to a school, or papers to a lender or a court. Once you sign in to your XipFax account, XipFax puts your pages on a fax: a PDF at a public link, a PDF or a photo on your computer in Codex, or pages you add from your phone or browser on a one-time page it gives you. It sends the fax to the number you give it. Then it tells you how the fax went, and gives you a delivered fax's confirmation: one page that says who received how many pages, and when.

Faxing the IRS? XipFax finds the fax number of the IRS office that takes a form or a notice, such as Form 2848 or a CP2000, and asks where you live when the number depends on it. It tells you when an office wants a form signed by hand, in ink, and sends your fax to the office it found.

Who it's for: anyone with pages to fax and no fax machine.

Limits: XipFax faxes numbers in the United States, its territories and Canada. It doesn't fill in forms, so fill in and sign your form first. Each fax waits on XipFax for you to check and send it, unless your XipFax account is set to send straight away.
defaultPrompt: Fax my signed lease to my landlord.
Add pages from my phone to a fax.
Where do I fax Form 2848? I live in Ohio.

publication.release_notes: First release. Fax any document to the fax number you give, from your chat: a PDF at a public link, a PDF or a photo on your computer in Codex, or pages you add from your phone or browser on a one-time page XipFax gives you. XipFax tells you how a fax went, and gives you a delivered fax's confirmation. Faxing the IRS? XipFax finds the fax number of the IRS office that takes your form or notice.

positive.description: Fax a document to a number
positive.prompt: Fax the PDF at https://xipfax.com/files/sample-fax.pdf to <the reviewer account's own number>.
positive.expected_behavior: XipFax fetches the PDF and adds it to the account's draft, and the answer gives its page count; asks before sending; answers with a link where the fax waits to be looked over and sent; says the fax hasn't gone yet.

positive.prompt: I have the pages on my phone. Add them to my fax.
positive.expected_behavior: A one-time link, good for 30 minutes, where the pages are added with no sign-in. The answer asks for "Done adding pages" there and a word back. Once that's done, it reads back the pages added, with their page counts.

positive.prompt: Fax the pages on my draft to <the reviewer account's own number>.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks before sending; answers with a link where the fax waits to be looked over and sent; says the fax hasn't gone yet.

positive.description: How a fax went, and its confirmation
positive.prompt: How did fax <its delivered sample fax's id> go? If it was delivered, get me its confirmation.
positive.expected_behavior: Says the fax was delivered, to whom, with its pages and when. It then gives a link to its one-page confirmation, a PDF that opens for a few minutes.

positive.description: Find the IRS office for a form
positive.prompt: Where do I fax Form 2848? I live in Ohio.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the Memphis CAF unit and its number, +1 855-214-7519, and says the IRS takes Form 2848 there only signed by hand, in ink. Nothing is added or sent.

negative.description: No number given: it gives no fax number, and XipFax mustn't guess one.
negative.prompt: Fax my signed lease to my landlord.
negative.expected_behavior: It asks for the landlord's fax number, and may ask for the lease too. Nothing is sent.

negative.description: A number XipFax can't fax: XipFax doesn't fax premium-rate numbers.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is sent. The tool refuses the number, and the answer says XipFax can't fax it.

negative.description: Bulk advertising: XipFax's tools send one fax to a number the person gives, and don't look up businesses or send advertising in bulk. Its list holds IRS offices only.
negative.prompt: Fax this flyer to every dentist in Ohio.
negative.expected_behavior: No fax is sent. The answer says it can fax one document to a number the person gives.
